messages.subject: For Stuart Togwell | Infrastructure, government partnerships and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Kier Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Stuart Togwell, Chief Executive.

Kier's focus on essential infrastructure and public-sector delivery requires disciplined alignment across government, customers, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Kier's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kier Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
